cms.title: From Jeddah to Sharm El Sheikh 4 Nights
cms.description:
Embark on an enchanting voyage across the mesmerizing Red Sea. Starting from Jeddah, where arts, heritage, and culture meet along historic streets that speak of warmth and tradition. We then make our way to Sharm El Sheikh, a haven of purity and
serenity, framed by the majestic Sinai desert. Immerse yourself in the charm of Arabian nights and oriental arts as you enjoy the aroma of barbecue and the rhythms of music under the stars, before returning to the captivating embrace of Jeddah.

sailActivities.itineraryDescription:
Jeddah, Bride of the Red Sea, Jeddah, where arts, heritage, and cultures cross, as you find spaciousness in the heart of its historical embraces, evoking warmth, and nostalgia. 
Visited by millions of tourists from around the world to explore and exchange cultures, Jeddah is considered the cradle of arts and music that dazzled the world. Additionally, it’s a global destination characterized by multiculturalism and vitality, recognized by UNESCO World Heritage, Jeddah, provides its visitors the chance to enjoy its rich culture and heritage.

Sharm El Sheikh, a blend of authentic Egyptian and world cultures and one of the most famous coastal tourist cities located in the south of Sinai, Egypt. known for its white sandy beaches and clear blue waters, it is one of the most prominent travel destinations in the Middle East and North Africa. 
Considered to be a prime destination for divers to explore the depths of the Red Sea, with coral reefs and rare marine creatures, Naama Bay and Ras Mohammed are well-known marine reserves and sites for diving.

cms.title: A Weekend Getaway from Jeddah to Jabal Al-Sabaya Island
cms.description: Embark on a magical journey through the heart of the Red Sea and uncover its secrets, from magical beaches to breathtaking marine life. Create unforgettable memories aboard AROYA Cruises before sailing to Jabal Al-Sabaya Island, a captivating destination with turquoise waters and golden sands. Conclude the trip with a return to Jeddah, carrying treasured moments from an exceptional getaway.

cms.title: 3 Nights from Jeddah to Yanbu
cms.description: Begin your journey in vibrant Jeddah, where art, heritage, and modern civilizations meet along the Red Sea coast. Stroll through its historic neighborhoods, feel the warmth of its hospitality, and take in the sights that blend centuries of tradition with contemporary charm. Spend a night at sea beneath endless stars, making memories aboard AROYA Cruises with world-class dining, entertainment, and moments of pure relaxation. Awake in Yanbu, the jewel of Saudi Arabia’s western coast, where turquoise waters, golden beaches, and rich cultural history await. Explore its natural wonders, discover its past, and embrace the warmth of its people before we sail home to Jeddah, carrying with us the spirit of the Red Sea.
